title: The Hidden Glow of the Sea

scenes.query: Mosquito Bay glowing bay at night
scenes.text: This bay glows brighter than stars!
Mosquito Bay is considered the brightest bioluminescent bay in the world.

scenes.query: Mosquito Bay scientific illustration of dinoflagellates
scenes.text: The unique glow is caused by microscopic organisms called dinoflagellates.

scenes.query: Mosquito Bay tourists swimming in glowing water
scenes.text: It's like swimming in a galaxy!
Follow to see the world's hidden places.

description: Discover the enchanting Mosquito Bay in Vieques, Puerto Rico, a place where the ocean glows with bright blue light from bioluminescent organisms. Experience this magical phenomenon first-hand and follow for more adventures!
